(4) The State of Montana has also enacted legislation for the protection of the air and water resources of the State.

These include: 
(a) State of Montana, Air Pollution Act; Title 69, Chapter 39, Section 14-25, RCM 1947.
(b) State of Montana, Water Pollution Control Act; Title 69, Chapter 48, Sections 4801-4827, RCM 1947.
(c) Act of 1971, Revised Water Pollution Control Act; as cited above.
